feature: PLUS court reduction (POST /v1/plus-apply-reduction-court): hanya mengubah amount_payable di Intranet dan Internet DB, tanpa TS-RED, tanpa baris suspended_notice atau reduced_offence_amount, tanpa idempotency
note: Varian reduction untuk notice di tahap court yang dikirim PLUS. Story OCMS16.11 sampai OCMS16.15 hanya menyebut reduction composition amount secara umum dan tidak membedakan jalur court. Menerima request, memvalidasi jumlah yang sama, dan menjawab pesan yang sama; perbedaannya hanya penerapan (amount_payable saja). Tidak ada story di chunk ini yang menyebut jalur court secara eksplisit. Keberadaan di prod dan pemakaian oleh PLUS cannot verify from repo.
note_en: Reduction variant for notices at court stages sent by PLUS. Stories OCMS16.11 to OCMS16.15 only mention composition-amount reduction in general and do not distinguish a court path. It receives the request, validates the same amounts and returns the same messages; the only difference is how it is applied (amount_payable only). No story in this chunk names the court path explicitly. Its presence in prod and whether PLUS uses it cannot be verified from the repo.
